inputHashScope: Composite library-owned archive projection, not a new runtime receipt. producer-runner entries copy exact original native report file hashes on the CI runner. source-head-767-git-blob entries hash exact Git blob bytes at the PR head, without BOM stripping or line-ending conversion. Head and Actions merge share the same Git tree; runner CRLF file hashes and Git blob hashes are distinct representations. This map is not the complete compiler/dependency closure. producer-paired-harness entries copy the 20 actual Windows producer runner-file hashes from the original paired summary; they are not Git blob hashes.
